title: Minimizing the Surface Area of an Open Rectangular Box
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: An open-top rectangular box has fixed volume V = 32000 cm^3. Find the dimensions x, y, z that minimize the total surface area, and compute that minimum area.
finalAnswer: x = 40 \text{ cm}, \; y = 40 \text{ cm}, \; z = 20 \text{ cm}; \quad \text{Min Area} = 4800 \text{ cm}^2

steps.title: Formulate Two-Variable Objective Function
steps.mathExpression: V = xyz = 32000 \implies z = \frac{32000}{xy}; \quad S(x, y) = xy + 2xz + 2yz = xy + \frac{64000}{y} + \frac{64000}{x}
steps.explanation: Substitute z from volume constraint into surface area formula.

steps.title: Find Critical Dimensions
steps.mathExpression: S_x = y - \frac{64000}{x^2} = 0, \; S_y = x - \frac{64000}{y^2} = 0 \implies x^2 y = y^2 x \implies x = y; \quad x^3 = 64000 \implies x = y = 40
steps.explanation: Set partial derivatives to zero and solve.

steps.title: Compute Height and Minimum Surface Area
steps.explanation: Substitute optimal dimensions to find minimum area.
